# Supplementary Table 1

Cox proportional hazards analysis of lifespan data.

All nonempty source rows are exported in the TSV files below. The first TSV column is the original worksheet row; remaining columns retain Excel letter coordinates. Blank rows are omitted, with their original row numbers preserved in subsequent rows. The displayed first 20 nonempty rows are explicitly a preview, not the full export.

Source: **PMC13645648** · original article license **CC BY**. Publisher workbook retained unchanged on RustFS. [Manifest and checksums](workbook.json).
